procedure_for_future_changes: Create a new change entry in this file with status PROPOSED.
Detail exact Previous Contract and Proposed Contract diffs.
Assess Compatibility Impact, Required Migrations, and Required Test Changes.
Obtain explicit approval from Project Owner before updating contract files or implementation code.
Upon approval, update status to APPROVED and record implementation date.
